verified_facts.text: The Grand Hôtel in Stockholm has hosted guests and events since 1874.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Grand Hôtel in Stockholm has been home to everyday bon-vivants and high-profile events since 1874.

verified_facts.text: The hotel sits on the waterfront overlooking the Royal Palace and Gamla Stan, Stockholm's old town.
verified_facts.excerpt: the hotel overlooks the Royal Palace and Gamla Stan, Stockholm’s old town

verified_facts.text: Régis Cadier opened the hotel in 1874.
verified_facts.excerpt: Ever since Régis Cadier opened the doors of the hotel in 1874

verified_facts.text: The Cadier Bar is named after Régis Cadier, a French chef and the hotel's founder.
verified_facts.excerpt: Namnet har baren fått efter Régis Cadier, fransk köksmästare och hotellets grundare.

verified_facts.text: The Veranda restaurant is known for its traditional Swedish smörgåsbord.
verified_facts.excerpt: the classic Swedish Veranda restaurant, renowned for its traditional smörgåsbord

verified_facts.text: The Veranda's buffets and smörgåsbord are served with the hotel's own snaps, Grand Hôtel Akvavit.
verified_facts.excerpt: serverade med hotellets egen snaps Grand Hôtel Akvavit

verified_facts.text: The Veranda offers lunch or dinner with a view over the water and the palace.
verified_facts.excerpt: Kom hit på en storslagen lunch eller middag med utsikt över vattnet och slottet.

verified_facts.text: The wine cellar holds Mouton-Rothschild from the hotel's opening year 1874 and Pol Roger from the 1914 champagne vintage.
verified_facts.excerpt: En av Sveriges mest heltäckande vinkällare erbjuder såväl Mouton-Rothschild från hotellets öppningsår 1874 som Pol Roger från champagneåret 1914.

verified_facts.text: The wine cellar's 2,500 labels focus on Europe's classic regions.
verified_facts.excerpt: Tyngdpunkten bland de 2 500 olika etiketterna finns i Europas klassiska regioner

verified_facts.text: The wine cellar can host private dinners for up to 8 guests.
verified_facts.excerpt: Vinkällaren rymmer upp till 8 middagsgäster

verified_facts.text: Grand Soleil serves a menu inspired by the French and Italian Riviera.
verified_facts.excerpt: Discover our menu with the best of the French and Italian Riviera.

verified_facts.text: The champagne bar next to the lobby serves top producers and vintages by the glass.
verified_facts.excerpt: Utanför Cadierbaren bredvid lobbyn finns vår vackra champagnebar där man hittar ett stort urval av de bästa producenterna och årgångarna utan att behöva ta in hela flaskan.

verified_facts.text: Room service is available around the clock.
verified_facts.excerpt: We’re available around the clock, offering breakfast, lunch and dinner and everything in between at all hours of the day.

verified_facts.text: The spa is inspired by the sea and the Stockholm archipelago, with saunas and a warm pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: Proximity to the sea, and the islands and nature of the Stockholm archipelago is the inspiration behind a spa far from the ordinary.

verified_facts.text: The spa offers Swedish massage, beauty treatments, personal trainers, a doctor of traditional Chinese medicine and a chiropractor.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy a classic Swedish massage, delight in a beauty treatment, be challenged by our personal trainers, visit our doctor of traditional Chinese medicine or stretch out with our chiropractor.

verified_facts.text: The spa has a minimum age of 16.
verified_facts.excerpt: Åldersgräns är 16 år.

verified_facts.text: The concierge can book everything from tables and theater tickets to helicopter tours.
verified_facts.excerpt: The concierge is always ready to book everything from tables and theater tickets to helicopter tours.

verified_facts.text: The Veranda has a smart casual dress code.
verified_facts.excerpt: Vår klädkod är smart casual.

verified_facts.text: Grand Café is in one of the small houses on the quay outside the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: I ett av de små husen på kajen utanför hotellet hittar man Grand Café.

verified_facts.text: Grand Café is closed for the season and reopens in spring 2027.
verified_facts.excerpt: Grand Café är stängt för säsongen, vi ses igen våren 2027!

verified_facts.text: The first summer verandas at the hotel were built 100 years ago.
verified_facts.excerpt: För 100 år sedan byggdes de första sommarverandorna här på hotellet.

verified_facts.text: The Veranda holds an annual seafood buffet with a view of the Royal Palace.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy our annual seafood buffet with a view of the Royal Palace.
